segments.t: Start at the Crossroads, level 20, just after turning in Harpy Lieutenants to Darsok Swiftdagger (The Barrens 51.6, 30.9). Your hearth is already set at Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind. You already have the Crossroads, Ratchet and Camp Taurajo flight paths. The speedrun quest log is empty; on balanced, Deviate Eradication (1487) may still be in the log if dungeons were on, and Orc or Troll may also still have Hidden Enemies (5728). Do not pick those up again. Pick up Serena Bloodfeather from Darsok, then continue Jorn Skyseer's chain at Camp Taurajo (Enraged Thunder Lizards) — Ishamuhale is already done.

tips.text: Forever profession rules worth using on this route: healing potions moved to First Aid; each corpse can be skinned only once; every profession unlocks a Camp at skill 20; crafting to sell to vendors no longer pays.

segments.t: End at Rog'mar in Riverglades, at flight master Grakna (about 59.6, 45.1). You should be around level 40-41 on both routes. Stranglethorn, Arathi and Hillsbrad chains above level 40, and the Dustwallow and Swamp of Sorrows chains, continue on the 40-60 route. All Riverglades quests below 40 are done, including 94483, 96063 and 96104 (the 40-60 route's first accepts need those). The Gelkis chain (including Ongeku, 1373) is skipped because it opposes the Magram reputation kept on this route; do not pick up Valley of Bones (93034) — that is the start of the 40-60 Shen'dralas chapter. The next route begins by flying to Rog'mar.

actions.label: Handoff: you are at Grakna in Rog'mar, ready for the 40-60 route

primary.reason: (dps) Leveling: Mining feeds Blacksmithing, which makes weapon and plate upgrades as you level; the Lodestone and Sharpening Wheel camp objects add melee power.

(dps) Level 60: Weapons carry warrior damage, so a smith arms both hands while leveling; at 60 Engineering adds bombs and gadgets. Fury should keep First Aid high because Victory Rush is its only self-heal.
(tank) Level 60: A tank wants shields, shield spikes and armor elixirs; Blacksmithing plus Alchemy covers both, and First Aid potions and cures are now First Aid-only in Forever.

secondary.reason: Forever moved healing potions to First Aid and added poultices and tourniquets; rated S or A for most specs. Level it with your cloth.
Food gives small XP and stat buffs in Forever and cooks build campfires for camp buffs; pair with Fishing.
Feeds Cooking; Fish Bowl camp object. Lowest value of the three for most specs, but it costs no primary slot.

levelingPlan.note: Copper in any starting zone (Poor Copper veins were cut in starter areas).
Tin/Silver in the Barrens, Ashenvale, Thousand Needles. Journeyman at 50 (level 10), Expert at 125 (level 20).
Iron/Gold in Arathi, Desolace, Stranglethorn, Thousand Needles.
Mithril/Truesilver in Tanaris, the Hinterlands, Azshara. Artisan at 200 (level 35).

(tank) Level 60: Shields, spikes and tank plate from Blacksmithing plus Alchemy elixirs. / (healer) Level 60: Mana elixirs and flasks first; Blacksmithing healing plate is BoE so it can also be bought.

secondary.reason: Forever moved healing potions to First Aid and added poultices and tourniquets; rated S or A for most specs. Level it with your cloth.
Food gives small XP and stat buffs in Forever and cooks build campfires for camp buffs; pair with Fishing.
Feeds Cooking; Fish Bowl camp object. Lowest value of the three for most specs, but it costs no primary slot.

levelingPlan.note: Copper in any starting zone (Poor Copper veins were cut in starter areas).
Tin/Silver in the Barrens, Ashenvale, Thousand Needles. Journeyman at 50 (level 10), Expert at 125 (level 20).
Iron/Gold in Arathi, Desolace, Stranglethorn, Thousand Needles.
Mithril/Truesilver in Tanaris, the Hinterlands, Azshara. Artisan at 200 (level 35).
Thorium in Un'Goro, Burning Steppes, Winterspring, Eastern Plaguelands.

Reach 75 and train the next rank (Journeyman needs 50 skill + level 10, Expert 125 + level 20, Artisan 200 + level 35). Feeds on Mining bars; Forever smiths also need Sulfuric Acid and Sandpaper from other professions.

Reach 150 and train the next rank (Journeyman needs 50 skill + level 10, Expert 125 + level 20, Artisan 200 + level 35). Feeds on Mining bars; Forever smiths also need Sulfuric Acid and Sandpaper from other professions.

Reach 225 and train the next rank (Journeyman needs 50 skill + level 10, Expert 125 + level 20, Artisan 200 + level 35). Feeds on Mining bars; Forever smiths also need Sulfuric Acid and Sandpaper from other professions.
Finish with Artisan recipes. Feeds on Mining bars; Forever smiths also need Sulfuric Acid and Sandpaper from other professions.
Linen to ~80, Wool to 150 (trainer teaches Apprentice and Journeyman).
Buy Expert First Aid - Under Wraps (1g) from Balai Lok'Wein, Brackenwall Village, Dustwallow Marsh (36.4, 30.4) at 125 skill; Silk and Mageweave to 225.
Quest Triage (id 6622) from Doctor Gregory Victor, Hammerfall, Arathi (73.4, 36.8): level 35 + First Aid 225; Runecloth bandages finish it.
Expert Cookbook from Wulan, Shadowprey Village, Desolace (26.2, 69.8) at 125 skill.
Quest Clamlette Surprise (id 6610) from Dirge Quikcleave, Gadgetzan (52.6, 28.0): level 35; bring 12 Giant Egg, 10 Zesty Clam Meat, 20 Alterac Swiss.
Expert Fishing - The Bass and You (1g) from Old Man Heming, Booty Bay (27.4, 77.0) at 125 skill, level 20.
Quest Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme (id 6607) from Nat Pagle, Dustwallow Marsh (58.6, 60.0): level 35.
